metadata.description: Small Claude Code mods: a cloud-session band, a status bar for the desktop app, a to-do band with your project's memories, and a graphite theme.

plugins.name: kit-cloud-pilot
plugins.description: Let Claude Code (CLI) run work in cloud sessions by itself: start them, track them on GitHub, wait for what they need and answer their questions with a signed reply.

plugins.name: kit-cloud
plugins.description: Your Claude Code cloud sessions above the prompt: working, asking, PR open, CI failed or silent, with links. Needs kit-cloud-pilot (installed with it).

plugins.name: usage-bar
plugins.description: See your 5-hour and weekly limits, context and model at a glance, in the Claude desktop app too: a status bar with reset countdowns and a daily pace for the week.

plugins.name: kit-todos
plugins.description: Your project's open to-dos above the prompt, most urgent first, with Do it now / Draft buttons and the project's newest memories.

plugins.name: kit-graphite
plugins.description: A graphite theme for the desktop and mobile apps: charcoal grays, a black accent, a dot field frozen mid-wave with drifting motes, and a pixel comet circling the middle.

plugins.name: kit-themes
plugins.description: Three original themes for the desktop and mobile apps: Paper (warm light), High Contrast (WCAG AAA) and Night (low blue light). Auto follows light or dark mode; /themes picks one.

plugins.name: kit-turn
plugins.description: A plain-language summary card at the end of every turn: what changed (files, +/-), tests, how long it took, and a warning with a Push now button when commits are not pushed. Plus a turn clock and /turn changes.

plugins.name: kit-agents
plugins.description: One card per running subagent: name, model, current step, context bar, elapsed time and state, with a waiting one highlighted and a Reply button.

plugins.name: quota-coach
plugins.description: See what is using your plan's limits and what to do about it: one-line saving tips, a why-did-that-cost-so-much card, a pre-send estimate and a daily report by session, model and hour.

plugins.name: kit-notify
plugins.description: A sound and a system notification when Claude finishes or needs you, a queue for prompts you type while it works, and a welcome-back card.

plugins.name: kit-pet
plugins.description: A small original pixel pet above the prompt that reacts to what Claude does, grows as you finish turns and cheers milestones. Three pets to pick from.

plugins.name: kit-status
plugins.description: A colored dot on each session in the desktop app sidebar: working, waiting for a background command, waiting for you, or done.

plugins.name: kit-safety
plugins.description: A safety net for risky commands: saves a snapshot before a delete, overwrite or force push, asks you in plain words, restores in one step with /safety restore, and hides well-known API keys and passwords in what Claude reads.
